entries.classification_evidence: Q0 FAILED on every qualification job (ubuntu 3.11-3.14, windows 3.11) with 39/39 checkers calibrated and 37/37 cases passing: two defects of the qualification harness itself (validation/qualification/q0.py), not of the candidate — (1) the scan for the pre-V2-006 probe digest read the harness's own committed macOS Q0 record, which names that digest as the amendment's 'before'; (2) on Windows only, the W0 identity was the raw sha256 of a CRLF checkout, while the V1 evidence guard (git objects) passed. Both fixed in the next candidate of the harness; the kernel tree is unchanged.
